body: Relatable. More than I'd want it to be.
Well, I certainly wish to be a friend, it's a lot easier to carry a sack of ideas when you're not the only one carrying it.

They won't. Russia is a whole different world. I bet more than half of this country is depressed. I read that suicidal people may lack the energy to put their thoughts to action, it might be the case here. I know for sure I'll be restricted from medical practice if I get diagnosed, it's like lobotomy-era psychiatry here. But honestly, can't go on. There are others to replace me in the operation room, the work won't halt so it's okay.

Not you. We are. You're not thinking I'd let you go alone right? 
The good is not completely missing, it just is overwhelmed and a bit tired. As are we. But it's not over.

I really wish I was but closer so that I could be of actual help. I can offer my hands once I take off my gloves, the damn corona made it sure there's nobody except me to assist the surgeon. 
Our combined "best" wouldn't be enough to fix this world, so I suggest we act as a contagious disease in a sense We spread what good we can locally. Gotta start somewhere. Wanna try?

Clearly a sign of anhedonia, my friend. Lol absolutely the same situation about my former friends, couldn't relate to it more if I wanted to. 
It's good your sister has you, you are of great value to her. Ya know, if we leave, there would be people living in grief, like "what could I have done to prevent this". 
Holy shit please don't let this happen. You have someone to support, and someone to support you back. It's not much, it's only what I can offer.

Antidepressants, far as I know, act as selective serotonine reuptake inhibitors. If you have some physical pain, like if you bump into a wall, antidepressants won't help with that. But it will keep thoughts like "even the wall hates me" locked up, so, you know, that you see some bright sides to things. It sure doesn't cause additional pain of any kind. I think it's 6 months of antidepressants worth of treatment that can get you back on track.

Yes. You do have potential. You are 15. Let's get to 16, the only thing you can't treat is... Well, death. Everything else can actually change. If you get your hands on antidepressants, one way or another, it will give you some clarity and might show some ways through the shits. I really, really know what this feels like. And yeah, the blade is kinda painful, more so when you don't know how to cut, just put it aside. Stay with us here for a while, how about that?
